items.title: Bill Kirchner interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 4, 2021
items.q: our first arranging teacher was Sam DeAngelo who was my high school band director

ctx.x: We held — our first arranging teacher was Sam DeAngelo who was my high school band director, rest his soul. He died a couple of years ago. But Dave and I had Sam for our first arranging teacher.

I went to his house to interview him and I was so pleased to see he had this whole setup with, you know, a big like draftsman table and he had the score paper and so I asked him about that. He said, “Well there’s something about the physical act of choosing a note with a pencil and putting it on the paper. It’s like you’re much more committed than just putting something with a mouse that you can easily go back and take away I guess.”
